title: Provider
description: A recognized upstream or first-party source. V1 note: no field under spec is read by the resolver — the Provider is loaded, existence-checked, and otherwise inert. Fields are therefore permitted but not required, and their shape follows the shipped catalog rather than catalog-spec.md:387-433.

trust.description: Baseline trust classification. Must come from explicit curation, never from popularity (catalog-spec.md:3385-3400). No policy gate reads it yet.
